argv:
A Meridian-3 has stopped reporting. How long can it keep working
offline, and how would I detect that from the Fleet Control API?

parsed.answer:
A Meridian-3 can keep working offline for up to **12 minutes** — this is the offline autonomy window, fixed in firmware and not configurable [sample_corpus/product-specs.md:Acme Robotics — Product Specifications > Meridian-3 Autonomous Mobile Robot > Offline Autonomy]. At the end of that window (or sooner if the buffered task queue is exhausted), the robot performs a safe-park: it finishes its current motion segment, pulls to the nearest designated safe-park zone, sets its beacon to amber, and holds position [sample_corpus/product-specs.md:Acme Robotics — Product Specifications > Meridian-3 Autonomous Mobile Robot > Offline Autonomy].

From the Fleet Control API, here is how to detect and track this:

1. **`robot.link_lost` webhook fires and `link_state` flips to `offline`** — `link_state` is `offline` when no report has been received for more than 30 seconds [sample_corpus/api-reference.md:Fleet Control API Reference > Fleet Telemetry > GET /robots/{robot_id}/telemetry].
2. **Poll `offline_seconds`** via `GET /robots/{robot_id}/telemetry` — this field counts up from the last successful report [sample_corpus/api-reference.md:Fleet Control API Reference > Fleet Telemetry > GET /robots/{robot_id}/telemetry]. When `offline_seconds` crosses the 12-minute window, a safe-park has almost certainly occurred [sample_corpus/api-reference.md:Fleet Control API Reference > Fleet Telemetry > GET /robots/{robot_id}/telemetry].
3. **On reconnect**, you will receive a `robot.link_restored` event and, if the robot did park, a `robot.safe_parked` event plus an amber `beacon` [sample_corpus/faq.md:Frequently Asked Questions > Fleet Operations > What happens during a network outage?].
4. **Watch the beacon**: if it stays amber for more than a minute after the link returns, a physical check is needed [sample_corpus/faq.md:Frequently Asked Questions > Fleet Operations > What happens during a network outage?] [sample_corpus/support-runbook.md:Support Runbook > Many Robots Offline at Once].

No manual intervention is required for the robot to resume — once the link is restored and Fleet Control acknowledges it, a safe-parked robot resumes on its own [sample_corpus/faq.md:Frequently Asked Questions > Fleet Operations > What happens during a network outage?].
